svg.title: Hermes × Revenium architecture
svg.desc: Hermes records classifications, API usage, tool events, sessions, and token usage locally. An out-of-process cron worker reads local state and is the only component that calls the Revenium API. Budget rule state returns through a local snapshot read by shell hooks before LLM and tool calls.
svg.text: LOCAL CAPTURE / OUT-OF-PROCESS METERING / STRUCTURAL ENFORCEMENT

g.text: task + job markers · API usage events
Plugin and hooks append locally; capture fails open.
No in-session network call to Revenium.
Cron worker is the only network-egress component.
Hooks read the snapshot before LLM and tool calls.
A block-state rule halts calls; missing state fails open.
